Fins of Destiny

Internal ID: TrinketChitinSwim | Type: Trinkets | Source: Forge | Crafting Materials: Chitin x5, Serpent scale x5, Serpent trophy x1 | Adrenaline Cost: 10 | Effect: +50% swim speed | -80% swim stamina usage | Duration: 2m

Introduction. Fins of Destiny are an Ocean-tier trinket.

Effects. Once 10 Adrenaline has been gained, the Fins of Destiny will trigger automatically, providing +50% swim speed and -80% swim stamina usage for 120 seconds.
